design.destinationSampling: Uniform with replacement over 12 fixed OSM destination candidates

fleet.assignment: First two accepted bookings fill both routes; subsequent insertions and flexible relocations must preserve two nonempty routes. Identical constraint for both policies. No equal-workload or equal-order-count constraint.

design.policies: All earliest versus all flexible, same offered order sequence; policy-specific history; only compare complete service of identical demand
design.interpretation: Computational pilot, synthetic orders, no participant or causal nudge effect, no calibrated real operations
